messages:
sara: Heads-up: I want to pin a new model into the catalog tomorrow morning.
sara: Model: cobalt-v2 (13B, int8-quant), reason: better latency on convo workloads with similar evals.
sara: Target canary: 10% traffic in us-west, start window 2025-10-21 11:30 PST. Rollout to 100% over 24h if no regressions.
sara: Who can own the deploy and run the quick smoke checks? I can handle rollbacks if necessary.
kevin: I can own deploy + initial smoke. I'll be around at 11:15 for prechecks. :+1:
liam: I can cover tracing + perf dashboards during the canary (console hooks exist). I'll post the dashboard links before 11:25.
cheng: QA: please run the prompt regression set (qa/prompt-sets/cobalt_smoke). Watch for top-1 changed responses >2%.
maria: Make sure quantization profile matches the one from 2025-09-30 (qprof-cobalt-v2-v1). Small diffs caused subtle length bias last time.
kevin: Notes for smoke (I'll run these):

```
# smoke generation
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"cobalt-v2","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox...","max_tokens":64}'

# embedding sanity
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"cobalt-v2","input":"sanity check"}'
```

kevin: I'll also run the perf script (3x short seqs) and paste p95/lat numbers.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by @kevin: cobalt-v2 canary -> 2025-10-21T18:30:00Z (11:30 PST). Canary size: 10%. Build: cobalt-v2-int8-20251018-rc3.
liam: If monitoring shows spike in p95 or memory, abort and pin back to cobalt-v1. Cheng, can you confirm automated regression alert thresholds? 
cheng: thresholds: p95 > baseline*1.3 OR top1-text-regression-rate > 0.02 triggers automated rollback alert. Manual rollback recommended if error rate >0.5% for >5m.
kevin: I'll keep the rollback CLI ready. Quick pin rollback command:

```
# revert to previous pin
redwoodctl pin set cobalt --version cobalt-v1 --reason "rollback from cobalt-v2 canary"
```

maria: Also check model artifacts checksum: sha256: a7f3...c9b2 — I verified on staging.
sara: OK good. Checklist for tomorrow:
- kevin: deploy + smoke runs + roll command ready
- liam: perf/tracing dashboards + alert watch
- cheng: QA regression alert config verified
- maria: artifact checksum + quant profile confirmed
- sara: will coordinate post-smoke announcement to #product and update catalog metadata

kevin: I'll post a short summary at +20m after start with p50/p95 and top-3 sample outputs.
sara: Thanks everyone. If nothing funky, we'll start gradual roll at 11:50 PST to 50% and hold for 2h.
kevin: Copy that. See you all tomorrow. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deployment started: cobalt-v2 canary (10%) by @kevin at 2025-10-21T18:30:05Z.
kevin: smoke results (11:37 PST): generation ok, p95 80ms (baseline 75ms), top1-regression 0.8% -> within threshold. continuing watch.
liam: perf charts look stable. memory flat. no increased error spikes.
sara: Great. I'll open a quick PR to update catalog pinned_version field once we hit 100%.
kevin: If anything changes, I'll run the rollback command and ping here.
